title: The Trouble with ODE: Polymerization during Nanocrystal Synthesis

source_inventory.title: The Trouble with ODE: Polymerization during Nanocrystal Synthesis
source_inventory.scope: Complete author and independent auditor reading of all seven main and ten SI pages: ODE polymerization controls, partial external-method NC syntheses and solvent substitutions, metal-oleate preparations, ligand exchanges, failed purification and measurement contexts. All missing external conditions and sample identities remain explicit.
source_conflicts: General source wording says above 120 °C while the quantitative series explicitly reports product at 120 °C.
SI p.3 calls manganese chloride anhydride; SI p.2 specifies anhydrous Mn(II) chloride. Nominal MnCl2 identity is retained.
Source n-hexadecane 12936.6 mg per 10 mL differs from its other mass/volume pairs (7730 mg per 10 mL and 11015.3 mg per 14.25 mL). No density-based correction is applied.
Oleic acid is printed as 0.1 equivalent, 28.2 mg and 0.3 mmol for 1 mmol iron oleate. These are not mutually consistent; all values are retained without repair.

S6 caption says pure ligand1 blue and exchanged NCs black; plotted D labels NCs+ligand1 blue and reference ligand1 black, while E also labels exchanged NCs blue. Preserve explicit source labels without silently recoloring or assigning by caption color alone.
Source literally states that after pumping TiO2 dry, redispersion is possible anymore. This malformed sentence is left unresolved; no silent insertion of not or affirmative dry-redispersion result.
S6 plotted sample labels and caption color assignments disagree; reference identity is not inferred solely from a color.
limitations: Cited external growth methods were not accessed.
Exact physical batch joins, unreported sizes, precursor charges and apparatus geometry are not inferred.
Source figure reuse permission is unverified.
